worldcombat.skill.defog.summary: Spin a clearing wind out from yourself: foes' screens are wiped away, smoke and ground hazards swept off, and those caught are left wide open. No damage; stand outside the ring and nothing touches you.
worldcombat.skill.defog.description.0: The gust sweeps %1$s blocks out from you; the ring you see is the area it tests. Every foe inside is caught, but nothing is damaged and no one is pushed.
worldcombat.skill.defog.description.1: Foes inside lose %1$s evasion stage(s) and %2$s defence stage(s), and those drops stay until cleared; the wide-open marker lasts %3$s s. Their Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Mist and Safeguard are removed as well, and smoke plus Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web and Toxic Spikes fields inside the ring — your own included — are blown away.
worldcombat.skill.defog.gale.on: Gale: radius x1.28, one more evasion stage and a longer opening, at +2 wind-up ticks and x1.15 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.defog.gale.off: Light sweep: a smaller radius and shallower strips, traded for a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.defog.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.defog.growth.0: From level %1$s the sweep radius rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.defog.growth.1: From level %1$s the sweep radius rises to %2$s and evasion loss to %3$s stage(s).
worldcombat.skill.defog.use.0: Wipe away every screen a foe has raised
worldcombat.skill.defog.use.1: Clear a field of smoke and hazards in one pass
worldcombat.skill.defog.use.2: Open an exposed window for the team's next round
On: radius x1.28, one more evasion stage and x1.15 opening, at +2 wind-up ticks and x1.15 cooldown, for clearing a wide area at once. Off: a light sweep with a smaller radius and shallower strips but a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.defog.preference.ai.ma: Only start a gust when a threat is this close; larger opens from further away.
worldcombat.skill.defog.preference.ai.mi: Only worth a gust with at least this many non-allies inside; lower spends it on a single foe, higher saves it for a crowd.
worldcombat.skill.defog.preference.ai.le: On: also leave a hold position to sweep foes.
